items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Benny was looking for a rhythm guitarist. I had a friend then who was in New York, a white guy by the name of Mike Bryan. He was from Memphis. A very good guitarist. And I recommended Mike for the job.

ctx.x: But any way, this was Kelly's Stables then, and Leonard was coming around then and Georgia All, so now here we go. Benny Goodman had Charlie with him at this time. This

is my reason for telling you this now. Benny was auditioning another band, and Georgie All had been coming around with -- playing with us, jamming with us all the time at Kelly's Tables. And he was -- Benny was looking for a rhythm guitarist. I had a friend then who was in New York, a white guy by the name of Mike Bryan. He was from Memphis. A very good guitarist. And I recommended Mike for the job. I was working with Roy, I was having such a ball I really wasn't interested.

So Mike got the job, and he and Charlie became very good friends. Charlie was a feature guitarist. And Charlie gave Mike a guitar and an amplifier. Well, Mike did not play electric guitar, so Mike in appreciation for my getting him the job, gave me the guitar, Charlie's guitar, and amplifier. It's the first electric guitar and amplifier I ever had. So this is why I started playing, and Roy would argue with me all night long. He didn't want to hear the amplified guitar, and I would play it anyway, you know. But he…
